intro: "Mathiel's Armor" marks the completion of an armorsmithing effort undertaken by Mathiel in the Warrior's Terrace of Darnassus. By combining his own night elven craftsmanship with innovative dwarven metalworking methods devised by Furen Longbeard, Mathiel reforges exotic materials into protective battle gear. The quest represents a fruitful blending of allied traditions in service of Alliance warriors.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I have finished with your piece of armor, and I am quite pleased. Furen's new techniques meshed perfectly with my own and I am sure this armor will prove to be quite resilient.
Thank you, friend. And may this serve you well in future battles.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
